ios.desc:
Notefuel is a note-taking app specifically for learning. Powerful, yet easy-to-use, Notefuel helps you take notes you'll actually review & remember.

Notefuel is perfect for taking notes on books, lectures, videos, and podcasts, and builds on research-backed learning techniques like spaced repetition and the Cornell note-taking method.

Some notable features:

• lets you turn your notes into flashcards by adding questions or having Notefuel’s artificial intelligence create flashcards for you
• sends you reminders to review notes precisely when it’s optimal for efficient information retention, making it easy to benefit from “spaced repetition”
• a built-in text scanner, which lets you use state-of-the-art, instant optical character recognition (OCR) to input highlights from physical books
• easy import of Amazon Kindle highlights & notes, empowering you to actually re-engage with and learn from your Kindle data
• works offline so you can take notes on an airplane, train, or any other place with limited connectivity
• syncs across devices
• share notes with classmates & colleagues simply by sending them a link
• doesn’t require sign-in
• freely export your notes so you’re never locked in

---

Subscription info: Notefuel Regular is the default plan, and offers access to all of Notefuel’s core features. Notefuel Premium is the subscription service and costs $12.99 / month or $94.99 / year. Premium unlocks real-time, cross-device sync and unlimited text scans and notes.

Subscription details: Payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours priorto the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.

---

quotes.text:
We recently launched precisely this - a note-taking app that lets people add questions/identify salient terms for review as flashcards, and ML that applies those questions to auto-generate fill-in-the-blank for any written material.

Would love to hear any feedback you have. The app is called Notefuel: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/notefuel/id1458567718

Shameless plug about our note-taking and flashcards app Notefuel that is built on this idea: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/notefuel-notes-flashcards/id1458567718?platform=iphone

Uses GPT-3 to generates question, fill-in-the-blanks, multiple choice and couples it with spaced repetition.
